scientific.integrity: The primary source and a later primary treatment were materially inspected. Searches covered notation, touching-translate, constant-volume, regular-polygon, and exact trigonometric-formula aliases. The theorem is proved analytically from support and radial functions; finite computation is diagnostic only.
limitations: The result evaluates the regular-polygon benchmark but does not prove that regular polygons minimize c^{tr} among all convex m-gons for m at least six.
The published values for three, four, and five sides are recovered rather than re-claimed.
Known Radon-curve theory already explains the constant-volume mechanism in the appropriate central-symmetral residue classes.
An unindexed later computation of the same benchmark remains a historical originality risk.

title: Exact translative convex-hull profile of every regular polygon
